name: xtermjs-skill

metadata.name: xtermjs-skill
metadata.TRIGGER WHEN: the user mentions xterm, xterm.js, @xterm/xterm, terminal emulator in the browser, web terminal, WebSSH, in-browser shell, or asks about addons like FitAddon, WebglAddon, SearchAddon, AttachAddon, or integration with node-pty.
metadata.DO NOT TRIGGER WHEN: the user wants a native OS terminal (not browser-based) or a non-xterm terminal library (e.g. VT100 emulator in Python).
